changelog.en:
What's New in Version 1.1:

• New Visuals & Polish: Fresh icon designs, dynamic 3D shield effects in combat, and smooth power-up card animations in the Market.
• Scaled Scoring & Leaderboards: Defeating tougher monsters now awards scaled point bonuses, with real-time leaderboard updates and run summary scores.
• Rival Difficulty Balancing: Rebalanced rival score scaling for a fairer, more competitive leaderboard climb.
• Audio & Stability Fixes: Resolved low-health audio muffle issues and applied shader optimizations for smoother performance across all Android devices.
• Google Play Cloud Save: Enhanced cloud sync for high scores, daily rewards, and streaks.

Thank you for playing Mini Match RPG!
